source: 2013/TSB Vol 13 No 09 New Slim Line Plug Adapters.pdf
title: Slim Line Plug Adapters for Engine Flush Machines
lead: MOC has developed a new kit of slim line plug adapters (Part No. 74860) for use with Engine Flush Machines. This new kit is easier to use and less likely to leak. A 90 degree Camozzi fitting (Part No. 94266) is included with the kit for use with the selected slim line plug; it screw onto the top of the plug. Connect the Camozzi fitting to the Hose Drain Plug (Part No. 74746) before beginning a service.
body: This adapter set is now available for purchase.
The individual Slim Line Plugs are also available separately. See below for the part numbers and descriptions.
